nodes.label: ADR-004: Provider failover advances at attempt boundary
nodes.rationale: Static single-provider assignment strands all requests when the provider fails, while existing circuit breaking only suppresses dispatch; switching must preserve produced context (CLI session history is local, message API is stateless) and therefore moves at attempt boundaries, never mid-stream.

nodes.label: Attempt boundary failover (unrecognized_model / HTTP 5xx / connection errors)
nodes.rationale: The chain pointer advances only between attempts; switch-class errors are unrecognized_model text, HTTP 5xx and connection exceptions, while quota/auth 4xx stays in circuit-breaker semantics; chain cooldown shares storage with breakers but uses isolated keys to avoid infinite looping.

hyperedges.label: Provider candidate chain failover flow (routing config → attempt-boundary switching)
